method: extrusion along x (100) of the YZ section: base y 5..60 x t; 90 deg bend annulus R 2.5..5 about (y 5, z 5); flange y 0..2.5, z 5..20. Setback (R+t)tan45 = 5 (inside bend position, outer-face height datum: outer face of flange reaches z = 20); V = L*A_sec, A = 2 A_sec + L P_sec
note: trim/setback and height datum are SolidCraft's documented edge-flange conventions (sheet.rs add_flanges)
